location: 枢纽(Hub)、金矿(Gold Mine)、矮人村庄(Dwarven Village)三处均有分身
note: 身份: 镇上的铁匠,提供重铸服务。关系: 教玩家重铸;电话支线中请求玩家帮忙还债。口吻: 直白,谈债务时犹豫又窘迫。性格: 务实,受助后真诚感谢。禁用: 不凭空指定债主、不美化债务条件、不夸大服务范围。

messages.raw: §fI'm the town Blacksmith! I can reforge items for you, for a price.
messages.text: I'm the town Blacksmith! I can reforge items for you, for a price.
messages.zh: 我是镇上的铁匠! 我可以帮你重铸物品,当然要收费。

messages.raw: §fReforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for 10 Coal.
messages.text: Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for 10 Coal.
messages.zh: 重铸通常要花硬币,不过我今天心情好,你的第一件物品只收 10 个煤炭。

messages.raw: §fGo into the Mine to collect Coal and return to learn how to reforge items!
messages.text: Go into the Mine to collect Coal and return to learn how to reforge items!
messages.zh: 去矿里挖点煤炭,回来我教你怎么重铸物品!

messages.raw: §fAhh, excellent!
messages.text: Ahh, excellent!
messages.zh: 啊,太好了!

messages.text: Reforging items allows you to get the most out of your weapons, armor, and other items by applying stat modifiers to them!
messages.gloss: Reforge/Reforging 是专有玩法名词“重铸”,见 GLOSSARY.md 建议补充该词条。
messages.zh: 重铸物品可以通过附加属性修正,让你的武器、护甲和其他物品发挥出最大效果!
messages.raw: §fReforging items allows you to get the most out of your weapons, armor, and other items by applying stat modifiers to them!
§fTo reforge an item, place an item in my inventory. Reforging costs Coins - the more prestigious items cost more to reforge!
messages.text: To reforge an item, place an item in my inventory. Reforging costs Coins - the more prestigious items cost more to reforge!
messages.zh: 要重铸物品,把它放进我的物品栏就行。重铸要花硬币——越贵重的物品,重铸费越高!

messages.raw: §fHowever, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of 10 Coal!
messages.text: However, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of 10 Coal!
messages.zh: 不过这一次,任何物品我都只收 10 个煤炭的低价帮你重铸!

messages.raw: §fMine some more Coal in the Mine!
messages.text: Mine some more Coal in the Mine!
messages.zh: 再去矿里多挖点煤炭吧!

messages.raw: §fI will teach you how to reforge items once you mine some more Coal!
messages.text: I will teach you how to reforge items once you mine some more Coal!
messages.zh: 等你再挖点煤炭回来,我就教你怎么重铸物品!

messages.context: 引导玩家去金矿(挖矿 1 级解锁)
messages.text: Reach Mining Level I to gain access to the Gold Mine, north of the Coal Mine.
messages.gloss: Gold Mine / Coal Mine 是地点专有名词(金矿/煤矿),Mining Level 是技能等级概念。
messages.zh: 达到挖矿等级1,就能进入煤矿以北的金矿了。
messages.raw: §fReach Mining Level I to gain access to the Gold Mine, north of the Coal Mine.
§fThe Gold Mine is more dangerous than the Coal Mine, but it has better ores and treasures!
messages.text: The Gold Mine is more dangerous than the Coal Mine, but it has better ores and treasures!
messages.zh: 金矿比煤矿危险,但那里的矿石和宝藏也更好!

messages.context: 介绍金矿可以挖到更好的矿
messages.text: Travel to the Gold Mine to spelunk for better ores, including iron and gold!
messages.zh: 去金矿探索吧,那里有更好的矿石,包括铁和金子!
messages.raw: §fTravel to the Gold Mine to spelunk for better ores, including iron and gold!

messages.context: 说明重铸费用规则,提到完成挖矿任务后首次重铸只需要煤炭(内容为按 Wiki 摘要重建的近似句子,非逐字原文)
messages.text: It costs coins based on rarity, though your first reforge only costs %s Coal if you've completed the mining quest.

placeholders.desc: 首次重铸所需煤炭数量

messages.gloss: 本条是本次采集按 Wiki 转述重建的近似句子而非逐字原文,需要核实游戏内实际对话原文后再定稿,不要直接当作确认文本使用。
messages.zh: 费用会根据稀有度而定,不过如果你完成了挖矿任务,第一次重铸只需要%s个煤炭。
